description: `add --dry-run` leads Critic on a vendor other than Builder's (`cli.py` `_cmd_add_locked` rules 1-3). Two vendors; Builder has only chatgpt so its lead is chatgpt, Critic prefers chatgpt too and is forced onto grok, Seer then moves off grok. Chains use current role keys. Writes nothing.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.aa-grok]
kind = "grok"
short = "ag"
config_dir_var = "GROK_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:grok-home}}"
pool = "grok"

[accounts.zz-chatgpt]
kind = "codex"
short = "zc"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "chatgpt:work"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[roles.builder]
write_scope = "none"
[roles.builder.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

[roles.critic]
write_scope = "none"
[roles.critic.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
grok = "grok-test"

[roles.seer]
write_scope = "none"
[roles.seer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
grok = "grok-test"

stdout_contains: leads on a vendor other than builder's
